entry.title: Evil Tuner XXL 0.2.0
entry.summary: # Changelog ## 0.2.0 Tested on an Akai Force (MPC OS 3.9.1). - PET: a second grain engine, CLOUDS (Mutable Instruments Clouds with the Parasites firmware: granular, stretch, looping delay, spectral, Oliverb, Resonestor) beside XXL GRAINS (ENGINE). The knobs show what they do in each mode. SCALE snaps PITCH (and CLOUD's scattered grains) to a scale; GRAIN SYNC puts grains on the beat grid. - TAPE: loops up to 3 minutes; SEND (the loop goes through PET / FX / SPACE / GATE, or plays clean); REC OUT
